sources: dossier=Net position: 'the reaper stamps ended_at exactly once ... and the liveness heartbeat last_progress_at' (2026-07-06, 3f71f90a, transcript) — establishes the write as sanctioned but never attributes it to 'the scheduler' specifically; doc=frame.md:37 and :45 both said 'the scheduler' refreshes/owns the last-progress heartbeat; code=the UPDATE lives in nodes.updateState (postgres/sqlite), invoked from lib/runtime/runner_terminal.go, runner_error_policy.go, wake_parked.go, and lib/control/controlapi/instances.go force-terminate, not only from the scheduler.
